sketches.mechanism: Ownership move semantics: passing a non-Copy value consumes it, and any later use is rejected at compile time.
sketches.resonance: What is truly handed over no longer remains available to the one who released it.

sketches.mechanism: NaN is not equal to itself under strict equality, while Object.is recognizes it as the same value.
sketches.resonance: Some states are made incomparable even to themselves, though identity may still know them.

sketches.mechanism: Assigning nil to a table field deletes the field rather than storing nil as a present value.
sketches.resonance: Absence cannot be kept in a place; when placed there, it erases the place.
